title: The VIX is the price of fear insurance
hook: Can you actually measure how scared the market is?
metaphor: It is storm insurance for a portfolio. When the sky darkens, everyone wants a policy at once, so the price of policies jumps.
body: Investors buy contracts that pay out if stocks fall.
The VIX tracks what those contracts cost right now.
A high VIX means people are paying a lot to feel safe.
Fear spikes hard and fades slowly. Calm is the normal state.

live.template: The engine reads the mood as {mood} today, and stocks are {spx_dir} over 3 months.

caveat: It has always calmed down so far. But these contracts expire and must be replaced, which quietly eats returns, so a floor does not make it safe.
